name: Battle of Madagascar
note: The plan shows only the landing at Diego-Suarez in May 1942 (Operation Ironclad), not the months of campaigning that followed. The accounts put the two landing bays west of the port but do not say which lay further north, nor the distances between the places; the positions of the town, the naval base and the line are placed by judgement within that.

phases.title: The landings west of Diego-Suarez
phases.text: The first wave of the 29th Brigade landed at Ambararata Bay and the 17th Brigade at Courrier Bay. The Vichy troops were concentrated around Diego-Suarez, and the defences of Antisarane lay ahead.
phases.quote: the first wave of the British 29th Infantry Brigade and No. 5 Commando landed in Landing Craft Assault on 5 May

phases.title: Both brigades advance inland
phases.text: The 17th Brigade took the town of Diego-Suarez after crossing mangrove swamp and bush. The 29th Brigade, with the tanks, advanced 21 miles towards Antisarane against light resistance.
phases.quote: they advanced 21 mi (34 km), overcoming light resistance with bayonet charges

phases.title: A frontal assault on the line fails
phases.text: The 29th Brigade and its tanks attacked the defences head on. Ten of the twelve tanks were destroyed by the end of the day, and the British had not known how strong the line was.
phases.quote: On the morning of 6 May, a frontal assault on the defences failed with the loss of three Valentines and two Tetrarchs.

phases.title: The South Lancashires work round the line
phases.text: The South Lancashires went round the Vichy defences through the swamps and rough ground, and swung behind the line. They fired on the defences from behind and took a radio station and a barracks.
phases.quote: It swung behind the Vichy line and caused chaos.
phases.note: The accounts do not say by which side of the line they went; the plan places them behind it.

phases.title: Marines land in the rear and the line is broken
phases.text: HMS Anthony ran past the harbour defences and landed fifty Royal Marines among the Vichy rear. The 17th Brigade broke through the defences. The South Lancashires withdrew after their radio failed.
phases.quote: At the same time, the 17th Infantry Brigade had broken through the defences and was soon in the town.

phases.title: Antisarane surrenders
phases.text: With the Vichy defence broken, Antisarane surrendered that evening, though substantial Vichy forces withdrew to the south.
phases.quote: With the Vichy defence broken, Antisarane surrendered that evening
